title: Maximum site cover
text: C3.1.1 Development on each site does not exceed the maximum site cover percentages of Table 3.1a. Table 3.1a Maximum site cover: R10 45%; R12.5 50%; R15-R25 55%. Site cover does not apply to R30 and above.

replaces.note: minimum open space 60/55/50% (R10/R12.5/R15-R25) -> maximum site cover 45/50/55%; 5 points more permissive at every code (C4P1-069)
open space column inverted to site cover

notes: diverges: same evaluator and values as ch3 C3.1.1, but the site is the whole lot (or parent lot under a strata scheme) on which the apartments stand (Appendix A1 'SITE', multiple dwelling or apartment limb), not a per-dwelling exclusive-use site; site.area_m2 and building.roofed_area_m2 describe the development lot. Table 3.1a (p27): R10 45%, R12.5 50%, R15-R25 55%; 'Site cover does not apply to R30 and above', so R30-R60 return NOT_APPLICABLE through the null table row (C4P1-068). 'Open space' counted eaves and open flat roofs, so the swap is not like-for-like (C4P1-069). M3.1.1 still refers to site cover at R30+ (C4P1-070).
